definitions.explanation: The current month; the month we are in now. Used to talk about events or plans within the present month.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{忙|いそが}しいです。
{今月|こんげつ}の{天気|てんき}はどうですか。
{今月|こんげつ}は{誕生日|たんじょうび}です。
{今月|こんげつ}、{新|あたら}しい{仕事|しごと}を{始|はじ}めました。
examples.english: I started a new job this month.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{雨|あめ}が{多|おお}かったですが、{来月|らいげつ}は{晴|は}れる{日|ひ}が{多|おお}いでしょう。
examples.english: There was a lot of rain this month, but next month will probably have many sunny days.

notes: Part of a time reference series: {先月|せんげつ} (last month), {今月|こんげつ} (this month), {来月|らいげつ} (next month). The {今|こん} prefix means 'this' or 'current' and also appears in {今週|こんしゅう} (this week).
